container: NumPy compressed NPZ; load with allow_pickle=false

step.unit: cumulative FIR in frozen training-standardized coordinates
step.if_omitted: Computed from standardized abp and cbv with 12 taps, ridge=0.0001

source_record_id.meaning: Source recording grouping key; must not cross splits

source_row.meaning: Zero-based source-array row retained for subset provenance

person_ids.meaning: Anonymized participant ID; repeated visits must use the same ID

sides.meaning: Controls must retain both L and R per record; stroke records must already be restricted to the symptom-ipsilateral side.

constraints: Signal arrays must be finite and use the documented relative units, not physical units or already z-scored values.
All surrogate rows from the same source record must belong to one split.
Every included surrogate pressure window retains exactly ARI 0 through 9.
Clinical labels are constant within a participant; side and visit aggregation precedes LOPO classification.
Model inference uses the frozen train-only scaler from configs/models.json.
The two-person JLU demo supports reconstruction and TFA, not AUC estimation.
Clinical input is already preprocessed: the NPZ loader does not perform raw-record cross-correlation alignment, detrending or resampling.

Clinical classification uses complete-record relative means; surrogate generation uses each raw 125-Hz window mean. The supplementary measured-CBFV prediction task instead uses reference-interval means only.
